Reading current parameters does not reset or advance the live laboratory vehicle
A complete A/B study runs two frozen requests and renders actual solver responses
Sweep configuration, archive export and imported-mode exit remain usable
Road-surface launch, ABS/TCS and wing comparisons are executable options in the same standard research panel
Channel, overlay, record switches and clear reset pointer series and units without waiting for another pointer event
Cancelling, closing and disposal stop workers and keep the active page intact
Historical fixtures remain readable and cannot overwrite or co-plot with a new model at the storage cap
Oversized old archives are protected before parsing and new session results remain exportable

liveExperiments.scope: Actual console DOM and actual fixed-step RoadsterSim replay/A-B. Canvas and asynchronous Worker endpoints are facades; no browser layout, Worker-thread performance, WebGL pixels or FPS evidence.
checks: Record button captures actual driving state, physical commands and immutable per-step metrics; JSON-all and CSV-selected have explicit scope
Original-condition 3D replay uses the actual solver and returns to a verified terminal state; replay does not re-run program commands twice
Measurement delay/noise and nozzle derating controls apply public physical APIs and are journaled during a manual experiment
An existing automatic procedure receives a full experiment snapshot and rejected / cancelled outcomes remain available
State restores terminate an old same-scene program and finish any new recorder before importing a different state
A solver fault or terminal-command mismatch during 3D replay retains a failed execution with its actual completed step
Without WebGL the same console disables only live operations while history, numerical replay and explicit controller A/B remain usable
A cancelled numerical Worker execution remains exported with source identity and partial statistics
A synchronous Worker constructor failure preserves the requested A/B identity and gains, clears Run / Stop state, and permits retry
Synchronous request and cancel postMessage failures each leave one failed attempt, terminate the Worker, and remain exportable
An altered retained sample produces the same completed-but-diverged verdict in live 3D and numerical replay, visibly and in exported evidence
Refresh restores the full replayable archive and metadata; history remains visible with live controls disabled

withoutWebGL.scope: DOM interaction, controller integration and renderer/scene routing checks. Rendering, camera pixels, assets, shader execution, browser behavior, GPU performance and visual quality are not validated by these graphics mocks.
checks: Actual app.js initializes the research shell before a deliberately rejected WebGLRenderer and resolves ?view=lab to the same-page study
Without graphics, the same-page standard study executes the actual solver and keeps visible history, selected-record CSV and complete-library JSON usable
English reaches the actual main shell and lazy research UI, persists and switches back without changing snapshots or exported history

workflow.scope: JSDOM text/events and actual numerical Roadster solver reports through a Worker endpoint facade. No browser layout, GPU pixels, native Worker timing or FPS acceptance.
checks: Input-only numeric edits immediately save the valid next-run request; partial edits keep it and rebuilding restores it independently of historical selection
Load historical configuration copies all request controls without running, changing the live vehicle or overwriting the selected response
Running the loaded history creates a new current-model record with declared provenance and explicit wet-road / assist labels
Selected old history and the exact completed pending request survive reopening and rebuilding independently
Editing while a frozen request runs cannot mark the new request as completed; restoring the executed conditions finds the real batch
Failure and a partially cancelled pair keep distinct execution states, frozen requests and returned reports
Interrupted browser execution is not reported as successful and a build mismatch cannot inherit a completed status
English research panels, chart labels and prompts use presentation strings while JSON/CSV, user names and physical state stay unchanged
Switching back restores Chinese presentation and preserves editable numeric configuration
The real 20-second roll completes and persists 400 samples; input-only selection of 8 seconds changes execution identity and survives rebuilding
Old 8-second request-format records and drafts retain their window and raw exports; imported frozen controls show the actual first request in both languages

vehicleInspection.scope: JSDOM interface and metadata regression with getContext deliberately returning null. Not a real-browser or image/performance result.
checks: 3D failure leaves truthful metadata export and language selection available while disabling PNG/ZIP frame capture and reference rendering
3.9 default / 3.8 retained options
Original-frame ZIP and independent-state JSON labels translate to English and back without storage identity changes
No-GPU metadata has null camera/resolution/device, separate surface protocol, and the actual chosen frozen reference identity
Independent JSON explicitly has current-state-unbound scope and null captureId/frameAssociation

robustnessStudy.scope: JSDOM contracts and actual solver reports through a Worker facade; no layout, native Worker timing, graphics or FPS acceptance.
checks: Twenty real reports, paired curve selection, completed-state persistence and unchanged pre-existing history/live vehicle
New controls, complete and partial results, and selected-curve UI translate without changing raw records
Storage ceiling retains all earlier records and warns that newer results remain session-only and exportable
Loading one historical robustness case preserves its full noise, seed, delay and fault request for explicit current-model recomputation

recoveryGridStudy.scope: JSDOM DOM/state/storage contracts and actual solver through Worker facade; no WebGL pixels, native Worker throughput, layout or FPS acceptance.
checks: Chinese UI runs sixteen actual cases, selects failed raw curves, exports the entire grid, and preserves the original history/live scene
Changed controls never relabel old results; a failed batch retains three returned results and all thirteen unreturned conditions
Zero-result cancellation remains a sixteen-cell incomplete grid after refresh, retaining execution identity and original data
Import/recompute reproduces actual curves; the 4 MiB ceiling preserves earlier records and keeps all new reports/failed attempts exportable in-session
